# Client for CrossCode Archipelago Integration

CCMultiworldRandomizer is a fully-featured randomizer for [CrossCode](https://cross-code.com) built on the
[Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg) project. Although the project is small, we seek to provide a premium
randomization experience.

# Discord Server

[**Join our Discord to help with alpha and beta testing.**](https://discord.gg/ZSWfgQdfGr)

# Setup Guide

See this [page on setup](https://github.com/CodeTriangle/CCMultiworldRandomizer/wiki/Setup) to learn how to play
randomized CrossCode.

# FAQ

Check out the [FAQ](https://github.com/CodeTriangle/CCMultiworldRandomizer/wiki/FAQ) before asking anything.

# Contributing

If you think you have an idea for a feature, read the [Contributing](https://github.com/CodeTriangle/CCMultiworldRandomizer/wiki/Contributing)
page to learn how you can help. No programming experience necessary!

# CC-Open-World

Previously a separate mod, CC-Open-World has been merged into CCMultiworldRandomizer.

This mod patches a lot of events in the game, in order to remove the story and freely roam as long as you have the access to certain areas. This is mostly meant to be played with Randomizers like [CC-Item-Randomizer](https://github.com/CCDirectLink/CCItemRandomizer), or [CCMultiworldRandomizer](https://github.com/CodeTriangle/CCMultiworldRandomizer) integration for Archipelago, though it isn't required to use any of them to play around with this mod.

There's a lot of vital patches that change how things work in terms of story and content, so certain areas are completely locked (either from specific questlines, or just entirely locked), or already unlocked from other methods. There's a small info [Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/buanjautista/cc-open-world/main/GUIDE) you can reference to know about these.

For more info on certain changes, you can check the [CHANGELOG](./CHANGELOG).

# Changes since 0.9.8

## Additions

* Added platform quest locations and Facility X goal (@buanjautista, #103)
  * Platform quests are in the pool when Quest Randomization is enabled.
  * Quest Randomization is required for Facility X goal.
* Added trap support and initial set of traps (@buanjautista, #105)
  * Full list of traps is available in the template YAML and on Discord.

## Changes to Generation

* The number of SP upgrades in the pool is now decided by an option, `progressive_sp_unlocks` (@buanjautista, #102)

## Changes to Locations

* Renamed Maroon Valley locations to "Valley" to make it consistent with other region names (@Valkhiya, #112)

## Changes to Logic

* Renamed all regions to more readable names and split regions into more granular chunks reflecting their actual location (@Valkhiya, #107)
  * This will also improve the user experience for the small minority of worlds that use region names for hints.

## Fixes to Logic

* Fixed many logic issues discovered while changing regions (@Valkhiya, #107)
  * **Ba'kii Kum Shade Statue** no longer requires **Maroon Cave Pass**.
  * **Encrypted Key: A Switch in Altitude** was moved to fall from rise.
  * **Crocus Pocus** moved to harbor from rise.
  * **The Observatory** moved to rise from wasteland.
  * **Heating the Hermit** moved to bergen from of mine.1, now requires mine.2 as condition (mine.1 doesn't contain carritrichs).
  * **Building a Base** moved to bergen from mine.1, now requires mine.4 as condition instead of heat (bringing it in line with egg pot botanics region).
  * **Raising the Steaks** now required garden.mid access instead of garden (garden doesn't contain bee hives).
  * Observatory goal moved to rise from harbor
  * Facility X goal moved to ridge from ridge.north
* Added bidirectional region connectors (@Valkhiya, #107)
  * Passage from trail to valley now requires green leaf and blue ice instead of just blue ice
  * Passage from fall to garden now requires red flame and green seed instead of just green seed
  * Passage from fall to ridge now requires red flame and star instead of just star

## Internal Changes

* Merge Open World into CCMultiworldRandomizer (@CodeTriangle, #73)
 * The mod will prompt you to uninstall and disable CC-Open-World.
* Introduced an automation system to cut down on packaging issues.

# Changes since 0.10.0 Prerelease 4

## Changes to Generation

* Merged Archipelago 0.6.8 into the development branch.

## Changes to Options

* Added a link to a wiki page about the different trap types to the description of `trap_weights`.

## Changes to Mod

* Modified certain game files to patch data rather than replace it (@buanjautista, #114)
